title: Egg Foo Young with {v}
steps: Sauté the {v} with the {spice} until just tender, then let cool a few minutes.
Whisk the eggs (about 2 to 3 per person) and stir in the veg.
Cook in a lightly oiled pan in small patties, 2 to 3 minutes a side, until fully set (160°F / 71°C).
Serve over the {s} with the {sauce} spooned on top.
tip: Pack the patties with veg, cook them in a little oil and go light on the sauce.
